answers.core: This is about improving the usability of 2D shaders for anything that needs to draw outside the node's original bounds.
answers.workaround: Using a non-repeating texture and region drawing in Sprite2D, yes. However, it's fiddly and can't be done with all 2D node types.

title: Add a Custom Rect property to CanvasItem to allow 2D shaders to draw outside the node's rect
